---
title: "Workflow: soil fauna metabarcoding"
---

From soil sample to sequence data. Each box is a protocol; dashed boxes are planned and not yet written.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A["Sampling, MacFadyen extraction and sorting of microarthropods<br/>(planned)"]:::planned --> B["DNA extraction, magnetic beads<br/>EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG"]
  B --> C["Nucleic acid QC<br/>EnGeL-MOLB-NAQC (planned)"]:::planned
  C --> D["Metabarcoding library preparation<br/>EnGeL-MOLB-MB (planned)"]:::planned
  D --> E["Library quantification<br/>EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA (planned)"]:::planned
  E --> F["Sequencing submission (planned)"]:::planned
  F --> G["Bioinformatics<br/>EnGeL-BIOINF-OBITOOLS4 (planned)"]:::planned
  click B "../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG.html"
  classDef planned stroke-dasharray: 5 5
```

| Step | Protocol | Status |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1. Sampling, MacFadyen extraction, sorting | MacFadyen extraction and morphological identification of soil microarthropods (ID to confirm) | planned |
| 2. DNA extraction | [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG.qmd) (magnetic beads) or EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL (spin columns, planned) | draft |
| 3. DNA quality control | EnGeL-MOLB-NAQC | planned |
| 4. Library preparation | EnGeL-MOLB-MB | planned |
| 5. Library quantification | EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA | planned |
| 6. Sequencing submission | – | planned |
| 7. Bioinformatics | EnGeL-BIOINF-OBITOOLS4 (OBITools4) | planned |
